The Pwm module shall provide the functionality of Pwm_EnableNotification only when the configuration parameter PwmNotificationSupported is ON.
The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_UNINIT , when API service is used without module initialization.
0% or 100% : Then the PWM output signal shall be in the state according to the configured polarity parameter

If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled, and a development error occurs, then the corresponding PWM function shall skip the desired functionality in order to avoid any corruptions of data or hardware registers leaving the function without any actions.

The function Pwm_DeInit shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter PwmDeInitApi { PWM_DE_INIT_API }. Regarding error detection, the requirements [SWS_Pwm_00117], [SWS_Pwm_10051], and [SWS_Pwm_20051] are applicable to the function Pwm_DeInit .
The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetDutyCycle { PWM_SET_DUTY_CYCLE_API }.
The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetPeriodAndDuty { PWM_SET_PERIOD_AND_DUTY_API }.
The function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmSetOutputToIdle { PWM_SET_OUTPUT_TO_IDLE_API }.

The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmGetOutputState { PWM_GET_OUTPUT_STATE_API }. Due to real time constraint and setting of the PWM channel (project dependant), the output state can be modified just after the call of the service Pwm_GetOutputState .
After the call of the function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle , channels shall be reactivated using the Api Pwm_SetDutyCycle to activate the PWM channel with the old period.

The function Pwm_DisableNotification shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported { PWM_NOTIFICATION_SUPPORTED }. Regarding error detection, the requirements [SWS_Pwm_00117], [SWS_Pwm_00047], [SWS_Pwm_10051] and [SWS_Pwm_20051] are applicable to the function Pwm_DisableNotification .

The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall be configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: PwmNotificationSupported { PWM_NOTIFICATION_SUPPORTED }. Regarding error detection, the requirements [SWS_Pwm_00117], [SWS_Pwm_00047], [SWS_Pwm_10051] and [SWS_Pwm_20051] are applicable to the function Pwm_EnableNotification .
The Pwm module shall provide the functionality of Pwm_DisableNotification only when the configuration parameter PwmNotificationSupported is ON.
The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_PARAM_CHANNEL , when API service is used with an invalid channel Identifier.
>0% and <100%: Then the PWM output signal shall be modulated according to parameters period, duty cycle and configured polarity.
If Pwm_GetOutputState is called before module initialization, or with an invalid channel, it shall return PWM_LOW .
The Pwm module shall reset the interrupt flag associated to the notification only when the configuration parameter PwmNotificationSupported is ON.
The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_PERIOD_UNCHANGEABLE , on usage of unauthorized PWM service on PWM channel configured a fixed period.
The PWM Driver module shall report the development error PWM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED , when API Pwm_Init service is called while the PWM driver has already been initialized.
